<a id="EscapedText"></a>

### Escaped text

`EscapedText` · `src/html.ts:130` · status: **held**

A text written in the content of an element or the value of an attribute: the characters that would open a tag or a reference, or close the value, are written as character references.

Section: 13.1.4 Character references · `https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#character-references`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ampersand` | `&` | Opens a character reference |
| `quotationMark` | `"` | Closes the value of an attribute |
| `amp` | `&amp;` | The reference written for an ampersand |
| `lt` | `&lt;` | The reference written for a less-than sign |
| `gt` | `&gt;` | The reference written for a greater-than sign |
| `quot` | `&quot;` | The reference written for a quotation mark |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `"a < b & \"c\" > d"` | `"a &lt; b &amp; &quot;c&quot; &gt; d"` | held, read as HTML markup |
| `"&lt;"` | `"&amp;lt;"` | held, read as HTML markup |

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `standard` ← [HTML](../.trame/std/docs/html.md#Html)
- Body: inline, in the declaration
- Read as: { before: <p title=", after: "></p> }
- Defined by: [HTML](../.trame/std/docs/html.md#Html)
- Read in: [HTML markup](../.trame/std/docs/languages.md#HtmlMarkup)

### Attributes

`HtmlAttributes` · `src/html.ts:16` · status: **held**

Each attribute after a space: its name, an equals sign, its value in quotes; a boolean attribute, its name alone.

Section: 13.1.2.3 Attributes · `https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/syntax.html#attributes-2`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `equals` | `=` | Separates the name of an attribute from its value |
| `quote` | `"` | Surrounds the value of an attribute |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `{"id":"Goal"}` | `" id=\"Goal\""` | held, read as HTML markup |
| `{"class":"banner","hidden":true}` | `" class=\"banner\" hidden"` | held, read as HTML markup |
